title: KGBridge: Knowledge-Guided Prompt Learning for Non-overlapping Cross-Domain Recommendation
abstract: arXiv:2511.02181v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Knowledge Graphs (KGs) provide structured relational information, offering a unified semantic foundation for cross-domain recommendation (CDR). Integrating symbolic knowledge with interactions enriches representations, supports reasoning, and enhances interpretability. However, existing methods face three major challenges: (C1) sensitivity to KG sparsity and popularity bias, (C2) reliance on overlapping users for domain alignment, and (C3) insufficient disentanglement between transferable and domain-specific knowledge, which limits stable knowledge transfer. translated_title: KGBridge：面向非重叠跨域推荐的知识引导提示学习
translated_abstract: 知识图谱（KGs）提供了结构化的关系信息，为跨域推荐（CDR）提供了统一的语义基础。将符号知识与用户交互相结合可以丰富表示、支持推理并增强可解释性。然而，现有方法面临三大挑战：（C1）对KG稀疏性和流行度偏差敏感，（C2）依赖重叠用户进行域对齐，（C3）可迁移知识与领域特定知识之间的解耦不足，限制了知识的稳定迁移。为应对这些挑战，本文提出了KGBridge，一个面向非重叠跨域序列推荐的知识引导提示学习框架。KGBridge包含：（i）一个KG增强的提示编码器，将关系级语义建模为软提示，为序列偏好建模提供结构化先验（针对C1），以及（ii）一个两阶段训练范式……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: KGBridge提出了一种知识图谱引导的提示学习框架，通过将关系级语义建模为软提示并结合两阶段训练，摆脱了对重叠用户的依赖，实现了非重叠场景下的稳定跨域序列推荐。
en_tdlr: KGBridge proposes a knowledge-guided prompt learning framework that encodes relation-level semantics as soft prompts with two-stage training, enabling stable cross-domain sequential recommendation without relying on overlapping users.
